headings.title: Definitions of principal business and control

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed adjoining-state reciprocal acquisitions/mergers, August 13, 1986 grandfathering, and principal business/control definitions.

headings.title: Subpoena research and copying fee schedule
headings.reviewNote: Sets reimbursement fee of fifteen dollars plus thirty-five cents per page for subpoenaed records.

headings.title: Affidavit in lieu of appearance and witness expense reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes business records affidavit 14 days prior and requires reimbursement of appearance expenses.

headings.title: Assessment of record production expenses as court costs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to tax association production expenses as costs in civil action.

headings.title: Immunity for disclosure in reliance on affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Shields association from liability to account holder for records disclosed in reliance on affidavit.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed $15 plus $0.35/page civil subpoena fee, 14-day release affidavit/witness expenses, court cost assessment, and affidavit-reliance immunity.

headings.title: Authorization to establish savings bank
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes five or more persons or holding company to incorporate savings bank upon director approval.

headings.title: Required contents of articles of agreement
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required articles terms including distinct name, capital stock, perpetual duration, and directors.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed savings bank establishment by 5+ persons or holding company and 8 required articles of agreement provisions.

headings.title: Pre-incorporation examination criteria
headings.reviewNote: Requires examination of capital subscription in cash, fitness of incorporators, and community need.

headings.title: Liability for examination expenses
headings.reviewNote: Imposes examiner expenses on incorporators and permits assumption by chartered savings bank.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed pre-incorporation capital/character/community examination criteria and incorporator/savings bank expense liability.

headings.title: Grant of certificate of organization
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of certificate of organization specifying capital and authorized business location.

headings.title: Recording of certificate as evidence of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Requires recording certificate with recorder of deeds as evidence of incorporation in all courts.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed director certificate of organization issuance and recorder-of-deeds recording as court evidence of incorporation.

headings.title: Powers limited to bank or trust company under chapter 362
headings.reviewNote: Restricts savings bank powers to those of bank or trust company under chapter 362 standards.

headings.title: Application of chapter 369 association governance provisions
headings.reviewNote: Subjects savings bank to chapter 369 provisions while excluding initial incorporation sections.

headings.title: Taxation as savings and loan association
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 148.610 to 148.710 taxing savings banks as savings and loan associations.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed chapter 362 bank/trust company power limits, chapter 369 governance applicability (excluding 369.019/024/034), and sections 148.610–148.710 taxation.

headings.title: Forty percent limitation on commercial loans
headings.reviewNote: Caps total commercial and agricultural loans at forty percent of savings bank assets.

headings.title: Fifteen percent residential and mortgage investment requirement
headings.reviewNote: Mandates holding at least fifteen percent of assets in residential mortgages, home improvement, and MBS.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed 40% commercial/agricultural loan asset cap and 15% minimum residential mortgage/construction/MBS asset requirement.

headings.title: Merger with or conversion to bank
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes savings bank to merge with or convert charter to bank under section 369.087.

headings.title: Application for trust powers under chapter 362
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes savings bank to exercise trust powers upon approval under chapter 362.

headings.title: Application of supervisory and enforcement powers
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 361.260 to 361.269 supervisory and enforcement powers and procedures to savings banks and insiders; retains original-rolls footnote (*Words "and powers" appear in original rolls).

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections, history note, and original-rolls footnote (*Words "and powers" appear in original rolls) in subsection (3); refined subsection (1) title to match "bank" rather than "commercial bank".

headings.title: Definitions
headings.reviewNote: Defines nonbank affiliate, nonbank business entity, and nonbank subsidiary.

headings.title: Merger with nonbank subsidiaries or affiliates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes merger with nonbank subsidiary or affiliate with savings bank as surviving institution.

headings.title: Submission and 30-day review of merger agreement
headings.reviewNote: Requires submission to director and review within thirty days for safety, soundness, and customer impact.

headings.title: Appeal of merger determination
headings.reviewNote: Provides appeal under section 362.040 and permits state banking board to impose conditions.

headings.title: Certification of effective merger date
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to issue certification of merger date for presentation to secretary of state.

headings.title: Limitation on post-merger powers and privileges
headings.reviewNote: Restricts surviving institution to rights and powers lawfully exercisable immediately prior to merger.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 6 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed nonbank affiliate/subsidiary definitions, merger approval, 30-day review, section 362.040 appeal, effective-date certification, and no-new-powers limit.

headings.title: Conversion, consolidation, or merger into savings bank
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes associations to convert to savings bank or consolidate/merge under savings bank charter.

headings.title: Federal association board certification and dissenter rights
headings.reviewNote: Empowers federal association board to complete transaction and applies federal law to dissenters.

headings.title: Articles of agreement and corporate continuity
headings.reviewNote: Specifies asset capitalization, continuity as same corporate entity, officer roster, and mutual option.

headings.title: Investigation, character examination, and charter decision
headings.reviewNote: Directs examination of asset value and character and provides appeal right from charter denial.

headings.title: Certificate of conversion and recording as court evidence
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance and recording of certificate of conversion in recorder of deeds office as evidence.

headings.title: Powers, liabilities, and vesting of property
headings.reviewNote: Vests all property and causes of action in resulting savings bank without deed or transfer.

headings.title: Consolidation or merger procedures under bank statutes
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 362.610 to 362.810 bank consolidation and merger statutes to all parties.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 7 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed association-to-savings-bank conversion/consolidation/merger, federal board certification, articles, examination, recording, property vesting, and sections 362.610–362.810 procedures.
